_r4_currency_rows(strength: dict, horizo: Return {basis:'vs_usd', horizon, rows, domain} from strength.horizons[horizon].
Each row uses vs_usd_pct for order, visible value and bar geometry; row.strength is not mixed into this surface.
USD is the zero reference and is not counted as a ranked non-USD currency.
Missing/nonfinite values remain unavailable and do not become 0.
_r4_pair_identity(pair_vm: dict, meta: d: Return assessed_currency/base, display_pair, quote_currency, invert/quote_orientation, signed_currency_move_vs_usd and displayed_quote_move separately.
For inverted market quotes such as USD/JPY, pair direction and JPY direction remain explicit rather than algebraically guessed by the template.
_r4_rate_gap(carry_diff: float|None, bas: Return side/favored_currency, abs_gap_pp and plain label; never return 'Paid to hold'.
A negative base-vs-US differential must say rates favor USD (or the actual opposite leg), preserving the original signed receipt.
_r4_liquidity_display(liquidity: dict|No: Normalize the existing canonical dollar-framed liquidity result into one display state whose label, explanation and signed net change cannot contradict.
Do not recompute WALCL-RRP-TGA or change engine sign conventions.
_r4_readiness(...) -> dict: Compose existing Forex source/artifact timestamps into the freshness_contract above.
Keep the function pure for unit tests; write/persistence remains with existing build/artifact owners only.
_r4_glance_vm(...) -> dict: Compose leader, breadth, principal constraint, attention items, currency rows and readiness from existing VM fields.
No new score or recommendation authority.
